summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist as specified. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (public loader plus private _resolve_path helper, stdlib only), an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection in docs/source/data.rst after Utilities, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist containing the four required tests. Verified by measurement only: no line in the three Python files exceeds 120 columns. Tests, black, and flake8 were not run, per instructions. Nothing was committed. Choices beyond the spec: a non-list value under the data_list_key raises ValueError; items missing "image" or "label" pass through without resolving that field; a directory path given as the datalist fails the isfile check with ValueError.
